overview: A green, hilly district in north Kerala with spice plantations, forest, waterfalls and treehouse resorts. Cooler than the plains and much less crowded than Ooty or Munnar.
fit: Good for both: nature stays, short treks and wildlife. Edakkal Caves have a steep climb that the 4-year-old may need carrying on.
season: Pleasant 18–28°C from October to February. Heavy southwest monsoon June–August with landslide risk; March–May is warm but fine.

gettingThere.detail: Chennai to Kozhikode (Calicut), then 2.5–3 hr drive up the ghat
Chennai–Kozhikode overnight (West Coast Exp) or to Mysuru, then road

gettingAround: Hire a cab with driver for the whole stay; places are 30–60 min apart on hill roads.

foodTips: Resorts cook mild food on request. Plenty of vegetarian options.
save: Take the overnight train to Kozhikode to save on flights
Mix one treehouse night with cheaper homestay nights
Book jeep safaris at the counter, not through agents
safety: Avoid monsoon months; 2024 saw major landslides
Keep kids close at waterfalls and slippery rocks
Don't drive the ghat road after dark
health: Leeches in wet season; carry salt and long socks
Motion sickness on the ghat: give medicine before the drive
kids: Pick resorts with fenced grounds and a play area
Do one big outing a day
Carry a light jacket for evenings

days.plan: Fly to Kozhikode, drive up the ghat, settle into the resort
Edakkal Caves morning, Pookode Lake afternoon
Early jeep safari, plantation walk, Banasura dam
Soochipara Falls, drive down and fly home
